title: Project file detail — remove the metadata strip

steps.headline: Is the metadata-free file detail what you meant?
steps.notice: Compare your picked quiet treatment, which still has the Project Instructions · Always · 4.1 KB row, with the same screen minus that entire row. It keeps the one-line file title, actions, approved tapered line/fade, unboxed explanation and full-width document. The underlying file information isn't deleted.
steps.risk: The text is a Workbench sample, not your CLAUDE.md; global files and other Project views are untouched, while narrow windows, editing, Android and contrast still need verification.
